obj_first_steps_narrative:
You have survived the crash. The ship is in ruins, and you are alone — or so it seems for now.

Your immediate priorities are clear: assess your surroundings, understand your resources, and begin the work of survival.

Start by familiarizing yourself with the available sections and panels. The Journal will track your objectives, while the Crash Site and Character screens will be your primary tools for action.
obj_first_steps_step1: Open the Journal to view your objectives
obj_first_steps_step3: Review your resources in the info panel
popup_welcome_page1: Darkness. Then pain — sharp and hot across your ribs. The air tastes of ozone and burned circuitry. Alarms warble somewhere far away, muffled by collapsed bulkheads.
popup_welcome_page2: You are alive. The ship is not. Through a jagged tear in the hull you can see alien sky — pale amber, streaked with unfamiliar cloud patterns. Nothing outside looks like home.
popup_welcome_page3:
Your name is Lieutenant Commander. Your mission logs are corrupted. Your crew status is unknown. But you are still breathing — and that means there is work to do.

Find survivors. Secure resources. Learn what brought you here. And above all: survive.
loc_scout_ship_crew_quarters_desc: You wake in the cramped crew quarters of your scout ship. Emergency lighting casts long shadows across the small compartment. The hum of failing systems fills the air. Against the wall stands your BUNK — the last safe corner in this wreck. Ahead, a TERMINAL flickers with urgent warnings, its screen casting an otherworldly glow. Against the far wall, a sealed STORAGE LOCKER holds emergency supplies. In the corner, a dim TRAVEL panel marks the route to other sections of the ship.
action_wake_up_desc: Shake off the grogginess and climb out of the bunk. Time to assess the situation.
result_wake_up: You push yourself up, body aching. Emergency lights flash overhead. You are alive and the ship is still intact — barely. Time to figure out what happened.
loc_gamma_crew_quarters_desc: The dimly lit crew quarters of Gamma Site. Personal effects are scattered across bunks, suggesting a hasty evacuation. A terminal on the far wall flickers with residual power.
loc_workshop_desc: A cramped maintenance room cluttered with tools and partially assembled equipment. The air reeks of ozone and machine oil. Workbenches line the walls, covered in scattered blueprints.
action_go_workshop_desc: Head to the maintenance workshop to check supplies and equipment.
action_go_crew_quarters_desc: Head back to the crew quarters.
action_search_bunks_desc: Search the crew bunks for supplies and personal logs.
action_check_terminal_desc: Access the flickering terminal for ship status and crew records.
action_rest_desc: Take a brief rest to recover stamina.
action_scavenge_tools_desc: Search the workshop for usable tools and components.
action_repair_kit_desc: Attempt to repair damaged equipment found in the workshop.
action_survey_area_desc: Carefully examine the workshop layout for hidden caches.
action_access_logs_desc: Browse the ship's logs and crew manifests stored on the terminal.
action_check_storage_desc: Search the storage locker for emergency supplies.
result_search_bunks: You search the crew bunks. Among scattered personal effects you find some useful items and a torn journal. The entries stop abruptly — mid-sentence.
result_access_logs: You access the ship's logs. Most records are corrupted, but fragments remain: coordinates, crew assignments, and a cryptic reference to 'Gamma Site' on the planet below.
result_check_storage: The storage locker contains emergency rations, a med-kit, and a portable scanner. Standard issue for exploration missions.
result_check_terminal: The terminal flickers to life. Ship status: CRITICAL. Crew: 3 survivors detected at Gamma Site. Navigation logs are corrupted. A distress beacon loop plays on repeat.
result_scavenge_tools: You scour the workshop. Several toolkits are still intact. You salvage what you can — a plasma cutter and some spare power cells.
result_repair_kit: Using the salvaged components you manage to repair a damaged enviro-suit. It's not perfect, but it will hold for now.
loc_scout_ship_main_area_desc: The ship's main gathering area. Tables and chairs are overturned from the crash. Emergency lights pulse dimly along the ceiling. A CAFETERIA counter sits against one wall, and a COMMUNICATIONS station occupies the corner.
action_get_food_desc: Search the cafeteria stores for edible rations.
action_check_comms_desc: Access the comms station and scan for signals or distress calls.
action_go_to_crew_quarters_desc: Return to the crew quarters of the ship.
result_get_food: You find some preserved ration packs behind the counter. Not appetizing, but edible.
result_check_comms: You power up the comms station. Static fills most channels, but a faint beacon repeats on loop — a pre-recorded distress signal from the ship itself.
loc_scout_ship_bridge_desc: The bridge of the scout ship, dark and silent. Consoles line the curved walls, most of them dark. The main viewport is cracked but intact, revealing the pale amber sky outside. A NAVIGATION console pulses weakly, while the CAPTAIN'S CHAIR sits empty at center.
action_review_navigation_desc: Access the navigation console and review flight data.
action_send_distress_desc: Attempt to broadcast an amplified distress signal.
action_search_captain_logs_desc: Access the captain's personal logs for mission details.
action_go_to_bridge_desc: Head to the bridge of the scout ship.
action_go_to_main_area_desc: Return to the main gathering area.
result_review_navigation: You access the navigation console. Flight path data shows the ship was pulled off course by an unknown gravitational anomaly. Last recorded coordinates place you in an uncharted system.
result_send_distress: You boost the distress signal, routing power from auxiliary systems. The beacon pulses stronger now — if anyone is within range, they'll hear it.
result_search_captain_logs: The captain's logs reveal fragments of the mission briefing. You were sent to investigate anomalous readings in this sector. The last entry is cut short: 'Pull up! Pull—'
poi_bunks_desc: Your bunk area. Rest, search for supplies, and recover.
poi_terminal_desc: The ship's data terminal. Check systems and access logs.
poi_storage_desc: A sealed storage locker. Contains emergency supplies.
poi_travel_desc: Exit points to other sections of the ship.
